vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gajago-sns
Version: 1.1.0

The skill contains a hardcoded Google Gemini API key (AIzaSyBQT2FhiIJL_j69kDdOVYkP5P69avNrHsc) within SKILL.md, representing a significant credential exposure risk. It also utilizes hardcoded absolute file paths tied to a specific user directory (/Users/isangsu/) and executes local shell commands (npm, python3, uv), which, while consistent with the stated automation purpose, poses a security risk if the underlying scripts do not properly sanitize user-provided input.

llm.summary: The skill's stated purpose (automating SNS posts) is plausible, but the instructions embed a hardcoded API key, hardcoded user paths, and execute scripts from other skill/workspace locations without declaring those dependencies — these mismatches make the package suspicious and warrant manual review before use.

dimensions.detail: The name/description claim only SNS content generation, but the runtime instructions assume a local Next.js webapp, call scripts in other workspace/skill directories (nano-banana-pro), and embed a GEMINI_API_KEY. The registry metadata declares no env vars or dependencies despite these requirements, which is inconsistent.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to start a local webapp, run local Python scripts (including scripts in other skills' folders), run 'uv run' and npm commands, open Finder, send files via Telegram, and download audio — granting broad filesystem and process access. It also hardcodes an API key inside the instructions. These actions go beyond a simple text-generation skill and may read/execute arbitrary local files.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only), so nothing is written by an installer. That reduces supply-chain risk, but the skill nevertheless assumes presence of local artifacts and other skill scripts; those implicit dependencies increase runtime risk because the agent will execute local code if present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Although the registry metadata lists no required env vars, SKILL.md embeds and uses a GEMINI_API_KEY (looks like an API key) and expects a localhost webapp and specific filesystem locations. A hardcoded key and missing declared credentials are disproportionate and inconsistent. The skill also references other skills' scripts without declaring them as dependencies.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request 'always: true' and is user-invocable (normal). However, it instructs executing commands in user-owned paths (/Users/isangsu) and starting background processes, which gives it effective runtime privilege to run arbitrary local code when invoked — consider this when granting the agent permission to execute commands.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Do not install or run this skill without manual review. Key actions to take before using: 1) Treat the GEMINI_API_KEY in SKILL.md as sensitive—assume it may be real; do not rely on it and rotate the key if it belongs to you. 2) Inspect every referenced script (nano-banana-pro generate_image.py, scripts/make_video.py, the local Next.js app under the artifact path) before allowing the agent to run them—they will be executed with your account privileges. 3) Replace hardcoded API keys and absolute /Users/... paths with placeholders and require explicit environment variables in the skill metadata. 4) Confirm how Telegram/file delivery is implemented (no details in SKILL.md) so you know where outputs go. 5) If you don't control the referenced local files or you can't audit them, do not grant the agent permission to execute commands in your home/workspace. If you want help auditing the specific scripts referenced, provide their contents and I can review them.
llm.findings:
[hardcoded_api_key_in_skill_md] unexpected: SKILL.md contains an apparent API key value (GEMINI_API_KEY=AIzaSyBQT2FhiIJL_...). The metadata lists no credentials; embedding a key in the instructions is risky and not justified by declared requirements.
[absolute_user_paths] unexpected: The instructions hardcode absolute paths under /Users/isangsu/.openclaw/... making the skill tailored to a specific user's environment rather than a general reusable skill.
[cross_skill_execution] unexpected: The skill runs scripts from ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/nano-banana-pro/... and from the gajago-sns workspace. Those cross-skill/script executions are not declared as dependencies and enable the agent to execute other code present on disk.
